notes.title: Post-Launch Update #2: Fishing, Achievements, and graphical updates
notes.content:
[h1]This update contains the following changes:[/h1]

Added in 10 Steam Achievements to unlock in-game, including:
Lumberjack!
Scouting
"Blank"
Friend, or Foe?
The Neetathon Continues
David
Sea of These 
You're a hairy wizard
Fisherman
Surprise!

Introducing fishing and fishing spots!
Find a fishing spot (marked by a sign) and fish at the nearby waters
Made some updates to the dialogue, added dialogue for the book/manga shelf

Buffed Lightning Spell to jump to multiple nearby objects
Changed damage for both lightning spell and fire spell

Made multiple graphical adjustments including:
Updated Sprite for the health bar, featuring Yukihiro's portrait
Added a visual cue when shooting enemies with arrows
Updated the mini-map
Updated the bed
Updated the carpet
Updated the signs
Updated the bookshelf
Updated the table and chairs

Fixed a visual issue where player could walk partially out of heaven
Fixed a visual issue when pressing shift while in the boat
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Upcoming updates and features:[/h1]

Next, we're going to be adding in the HD versions of the goddesses to the game, as well as HD backgrounds, text boxes, and text. You will be able to switch from pixelated to HD from options. 

Additionally, we'd also like to encourage players exploring the world rather than just staying in the grassland. So to combat this we are considering making it so that resources do not respawn. The player will have to get resources from a broader area, and could only get the previously mined resources back by an undecided reset feature. Perhaps world resetting, or sapling planting, and etc.

Along with the HD dialogue update we plan to also have much more dialogue to experience, for the players that have already read all the dialogue currently in the game.

We will also be allowing the customization of the house you purchase, including the floors, walls, and items residing within the home. Items will be able to be found in the world, purchased from NPC's, or earned from side quests which will also be added into the game asap.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]If you would like to suggest side quests ideas, items you could buy to put into your home, or anything else, please consider joining the discord community to submit your ideas to the developers.[/b]

As always, thank you all for your support and your feedback, cheers!

notes.title: Post-Launch Update: Nurse character + Bug Fixes
notes.content:
This following update contains the following changes:

You no longer heal up after every battle
Nurse character that heals you for 2 apples
UI now has a healthbar in the top left corner
Goddesses Blessing (Heal) is now doubled
Enemies do slightly less damage

New dialogue for Natsuko (Green goddess with brown hair)

New sound effect for attacking enemies
New sound effect for completing a battle
New sound effect for healing yourself

Fixed an issue with fireballs rarely crashing the game
Fixed a rare case "infinite looping dialogue" glitch with Natsuko
Fixed an issue where materials would spawn inside a bridge or dock
Fixed mana consumption happening before confirming an action in battles
Fixed an issue with being unable to backtrack in battle menus by pressing escape
Fixed an issue that would put the character in the middle of the ocean in very rare cases

Added in multiple new areas where the game auto-saves to minimize progress loss
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As always, thank you all for your support and feedback!
Be sure to consider joining our discord to continue to make this game better and better^^
